title: A rotary prefix leaves an exact identity tail
purpose: Separate the even rotated prefix from trailing channels in an odd-width head.
contract: Dh = 5, R = 4, theta = 100, position 1; frequencies use the selected prefix width R.
Every finite trailing F32 value retains its original bits, including negative zero.
